explanation: Subtract a chosen jug’s low/high bounds from the remaining target interval. Memoize remainder intervals and accept when a jug interval fits entirely inside the remaining requirement.
timeComplexity: O(mS) for m jugs and S memoized remainder states
spaceComplexity: O(S+D), with D the maximum recursion depth
